title: Convert to any base
hints: Repeated division: `n % base` is the last digit and `n / base` is what remains. Repeat until nothing remains. The digits come out **right to left**.
Keep `const digits = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"`; `digits[d]` is the byte for digit value `d`, and `string(digits[d]) + s` prepends it. Handle `base` out of range and `n == 0` first.

For negatives, don't negate the `int` (that breaks on `math.MinInt`). Use `u := uint(n); if n < 0 { u = -u }` — unsigned negation wraps to the right magnitude — then divide `u` by `uint(base)` and add the `"-"` at the end.
